kill_fact: The position dies on STRUCTURE, not arithmetic - which matters, because this pass overturns load-bearing numbers on BOTH sides and the kill survives every one of them. (1) THE CATALYST IS SOFT, UNDATED AND REVOCABLE. Primary source, 18 Feb 2026 IR release: the board 'unanimously approved a plan to EXPLORE a possible spin-off' and, verbatim, 'The Company has not set a timetable for completion of this process,' with 'no assurance that the possible transaction will be completed in the manner described above, or at all.' Primary source, 18 May 2026 IR release: the Form 10 was filed CONFIDENTIALLY (the company's own word) and completion 'would be subject to various conditions, including effectiveness of the Form 10 Registration Statement, any required league approval, receipt of a tax opinion from counsel and Company board approval.' COMPANY BOARD APPROVAL IS ENUMERATED AS AN OUTSTANDING CONDITION five months after the announcement and two months after the Form 10 - the board approved looking, not doing. The operative verb never upgraded: 'If MSG Sports proceeds with the spin-off transaction.' As of 16 Jul 2026 there is no record date, no effective date, no distribution ratio, no pro-formas, no public debt allocation, no confirmed NBA/NHL approval, no merger agreement, no counterparty and no reverse break fee. Nothing pays a shareholder a defined sum on a defined date; management can let the option lapse at zero cost, and every remaining gate is discretionary and Dolan- or league-controlled. (2) THE FLOOR DOES NOT EXIST. Verified to the dollar against the Q3 FY2026 balance sheet (period 31 Mar 2026, filed 8 May 2026, CIK 0001636519): total stockholders' equity NEGATIVE $295.450mm; total liabilities $1,804.797mm vs total assets $1,509.347mm; cash $107.039mm; TTM operating loss; no dividend. No deal exists, therefore no deal-break price; no cash pile, no recovery value, no contractual backstop of any kind. What sits under the stock is the market's willingness to keep applying a ~23% discount instead of the ~47% it applied a year ago - a SENTIMENT level, not cash, contract or book value - to Sportico's $13.5bn appraisal, which is an opinion with no transaction behind it, struck at the top of the sports-valuation cycle weeks after the Knicks' first title in 53 years, and pro-cyclical by construction. Franchise marks backstop a whole-asset private buyer; they never backstop a minority public holder sitting beneath Class B supervoting shares that survive the split intact in BOTH new companies. (3) THE STATED EDGE IS UNAVAILABLE AT THE SECURITY BEING UNDERWRITTEN - the hidden disqualifier, and the cleanest kill because it is immune to every number in dispute. The driver is labelled 'Spin_index_flow,' but a spin-off creates NO index buying in the PARENT. The forced-seller supply this funnel exists to harvest materialises in the newly issued Rangers stub, when funds that cannot hold a small unrated new issue liquidate it - after a record date that does not exist. Buying MSGS today to capture it means paying full price for the whole to receive a discounted stub later. The mechanism is backwards. (4) THE RESIDUAL BULL STEP IS BEING WALKED BACK. Primary source, 3 Jul 2026: Quentin Dolan named President, COO and ALTERNATE GOVERNOR of the Rangers, assuming 'a key role in the day-to-day Ownership responsibilities,' with James Dolan stepping back from day-to-day Rangers duties and President/GM Chris Drury reporting into him - the first time in 27 years James Dolan has scaled back on either team, six weeks after filing to separate that exact asset. The alternate-governor chair is the seat an owner occupies at league meetings; you fill it with your son to HOLD for thirty years, not to sell. Sportico corroborates that while multiple investors speculate on an outright sale, 'someone familiar with spinoff details disputed this premise,' and Seaport's David Joyce (April 2026 note) confines the benefit to making 'minority stake sales easier' - minority stakes transfer no control and pay public holders nothing. CONCEDED HONESTLY: the two corrections below CUT TOWARD THE BULL and materially narrow the inverted asymmetry the dossier claims - real downside is ~-15% to a corrected ~$328, not -25% to $291, and live street consensus is $438.40 with the LOWEST covering target ($400) still ABOVE the live $387.41. The dossier's 0.55:1 is really closer to 0.9:1. That is a fairer bet than the dossier states and it is stated plainly here. It still does not clear this book's bar: a roughly symmetric payoff on an undated, non-binding corporate option, with negative book equity, no cash, no contract and no floor beneath it, bought 5.9% below an all-time high after a +105% run - is not an asymmetry. The dossier's directional call (verdict C, conviction 2, 'Pass for now') is correct and its conclusion survives; two of its supporting numbers do not.
corrections: Four items. Two are material and BOTH cut toward the bull - disclosed because a skeptic that only finds convenient errors is not doing the job. (1) MATERIAL, TOWARD THE BULL - THE NET-DEBT SUBTRACTION IS MISCONSTRUCTED AND IT IS LOAD-BEARING IN EVERY SoP LINE. The dossier subtracts 'net debt of $1.06B' in the $515 ceiling, the $398 fair-value bridge, and both bear cases ($291/$320/$250). But per the filed Q3 FY2026 balance sheet, $852.308mm of the $1,167.793mm total debt is CAPITAL/FINANCE LEASE OBLIGATIONS - the MSG arena license capitalised under ASC 842, carrying an offsetting right-of-use asset inside the $771.450mm PP&E line - not funded borrowings. FUNDED debt is $315.485mm ($73.485mm current + $242.0mm long-term); net FUNDED debt is ~$208mm, not $1.06bn. The Sportico/Forbes marks appraise the Knicks and Rangers as going concerns ALREADY playing at the Garden under that license, so the license burden is embedded in the cash flows behind the mark; subtracting the capitalised obligation again double-counts it. Corrected: full-mark ceiling ~$552/sh (not $515); the 40%-discount adverse case ~$328/sh (not $291); the 35% case ~$356/sh (not $320). The 'verified downside floor' of $291 is therefore ~13% too low and modelled downside is ~-15%, not -25%. HONEST CAVEAT: this hinges on Sportico's methodology, which is not public - if its mark is struck on an unlevered basis that ignores the license, the dossier's convention is defensible. The point is that the dossier does not acknowledge the ambiguity at all and lends false precision to a number it calls a floor. Under EITHER convention the support level is a sentiment discount, not cash - so the kill is untouched, and if anything sharpened. (2) MATERIAL, TOWARD THE BULL - THE ANALYST CONSENSUS IS WRONG IN THE DOSSIER AND WRONG AGAIN IN THE PRIOR SKEPTIC PASS, IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS. Live data (16 Jul 2026): consensus $438.40, median $435, high $477, LOW $400; 9 covering analysts last quarter, 2 in the last month averaging $440. The dossier's '$423.50 (five analysts, high $470, low $360)' is stale and too low; the superseded 2026-07-16 shard's '$398.33 (eight analysts),' on which it rested its 'only 2.5% to consensus' spread-is-gone leg, is materially too low and that leg is hereby withdrawn - the street sees ~+13.2% to consensus, not +2.5%. The sharpest version of this fact is one NEITHER prior pass surfaced: the LOWEST covering price target on the tape ($400) sits ABOVE the live price of $387.41. Not one covering analyst is below the stock. That is the strongest single datapoint against this pass's own conclusion and it is recorded here without softening. It does not change the verdict, because a price target is a point estimate of a favourable path and not a floor, and because unanimous sell-side agreement at a record high is a description of crowding, not of asymmetry - but the dossier's 'the street is not offside' concession is understated, and its $423.50 corroboration of the $440 target is circular against a live $438.40. (3) MINOR, AGAINST THE BULL - the Joyce 'minority stake sales easier' quote is from an APRIL 2026 research note; the dossier leaves it undated. (4) MINOR, AGAINST THE BULL, NET - discount framing: Sportico reported a 29% discount as of the 18 May 2026 filing date; at the live $387.41 (mkt cap $9.327bn + $1.061bn conventional net debt = $10.39bn EV vs the $13.5bn mark) it is ~23%, so the correct arc is ~47% a year ago -> 29% at the Form 10 -> ~23% today. The dossier's '24%' is right; compression is marginally understated. Also: shares verify at ~24.08mm implied vs the dossier's 24.149mm (immaterial); the 18 May release DOES disclose a distribution structure ('record holders of Company Class A and Class B common stock would receive a pro-rata distribution of 100% of the common stock in the newly created public company') but no ratio, date or pro-formas, so 'no share ratio' stands. On the Sportico sale question the dossier's 'actively contradicted' slightly over-reaches: the source reports a dispute by someone familiar AND a spokesperson DECLINING to comment - a non-denial is not a denial. It is also not a dated, binding catalyst. LINEAGE: supersedes the 2026-07-13 and 2026-07-16 skeptic passes, which reached the same REFUTED/catalyst conclusion. This pass PRESERVES their verified findings (the 18 Feb 'no timetable' verbatim, the Quentin Dolan succession, the omitted half of the Sportico quote, and the net-debt-composition correction, which is independently re-verified here), WITHDRAWS the prior pass's '$398.33 / trades below consensus by 2.5%' leg as factually wrong against live data, and adds the finding that the entire covering analyst range now sits above the live price.
